rf_supply: No evidence found. Indian Kanoon full-text search for "Enertech UPS" + Russia returned 0 matching results (https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=%22Enertech%20UPS%22%20Russia). Company website (enertechups.com) lists global installed capacity by region — India 480 MW, Middle East 60 MW, Africa 30 MW, Southeast Asia 20 MW, Others 10 MW — with no mention of Russia or CIS markets; these are self-declared marketing figures, not shipment records. No customs/B-L, tender or contract record evidencing supply to Russia or the CIS was located. Status: not confirmed / no traces found.
note: Risk-only scope. Sanctions: no OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK or BIS Entity List listing found for this name; however, the sanctions screening was done via general web search only (search backend down, Google/DDG blocked), so a formal screening against the consolidated lists was NOT completed — treat sanctions_hit=null as 'not verified', not as 'clear'. Court record: five matters on Indian Kanoon, all routine — four income-tax/customs-excise tax appeals (2001, 2022, 2025) and one consumer complaint (NCDRC/SCDRC, 29.02.2024) where the company is an opposite party. Per project rule 2 these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds. Credit rating: no public rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite) found; null. Revenue/export volumes and legal identity deliberately not researched per role scope. Overall: no rejection ground identified; the only substantive gap is that sanctions and open-web news screening could not be completed with the available tools.
